summary: The submission satisfies the contract: four typed TanStack Router pages (growth, moments, guide, profile/me) reproduce the Stitch IA with purely local interactions, and every acceptance item is evidenced — TDD red/green with 8 passing tests, TypeScript --noEmit typecheck, Vite production build with route-level chunks, scoped Biome lint, mobile QA on all four routes with a clean console, and a desktop check confirming the 768px responsive container. Scope constraints are respected: evidence explicitly confirms no remote fetch, auth, database, upload, deployment, or external persistence, consistent with the frontend-only phase-one mandate. No P0-category findings (no secrets/PII, no destructive operations, no auth surface, no supply-chain or RCE vectors) are present in the bundle. Two low-severity, non-blocking observations are noted regarding desktop QA breadth and per-interaction test itemization. Verdict: pass.
